rules: not operationalisable: epistemic posture with no decision rule: the concept only says the weekly profile is not assigned before the week trades; it names no pre-week classifier to score (the 'Monday-morning guess' is unspecified and the profile set is not enumerated in wGYde-h84cs), so no OHLC statistic can confirm or refute it; its operative parts (skip Monday; confirm by hourly CISD at the manipulation) are the separate concepts no-monday-rule and hourly-cisd-manipulation-confirmation
